mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mapper.WepTrlInspResultMapper.selectWebTrlInspResultList : 웹심리검사 결과 LIST */ AA.GROUP_NM AS LCLAS_TYPE_SE_NM , AA.TRL_INSP_LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD , BB.GROUP_NM AS MLSFC_TYPE_SE_NM , BB.TRL_INSP_MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD , CC.GROUP_NM AS SCLAS_TYPE_SE_NM , CC.TRL_INSP_SCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD , '결과설명보기' AS 결과설명보기 FROM AYD200 AA /* 심리검사카테고리1 */ , AYD210 BB /* 심리검사카테고리2 */ , AYD220 CC /* 심리검사카테고리3 */ WHERE 1=1 AND BB.TRL_INSP_LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.TRL_INSP_LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD AND CC.TRL_INSP_MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD = BB.TRL_INSP_MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD ORDER BY 2, 4, 6

WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{TRL_INSP_LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD} AS LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD , #{TRL_INSP_MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD} AS MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD , #{TRL_INSP_SCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD} AS SCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mapper.WepTrlInspResultMapper.selectWebTrlInspResultDetail : 웹심리검사 결과 상세 LIST */ DD.TRL_INSP_SCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD , DD.SCORE_SCP_NM , DD.SCORE_SCP_RESULT_CN FROM AYD200 AA /* 심리검사카테고리1 */ , AYD210 BB /* 심리검사카테고리2 */ , AYD220 CC /* 심리검사카테고리3 */ , AYD280 DD /* 심리검사카테고리설명 */ , ZZ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.TRL_INSP_LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD = ZZ.LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.TRL_INSP_MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD = ZZ.MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD AND CC.TRL_INSP_SCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD = ZZ.SCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.TRL_INSP_LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.TRL_INSP_LCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD AND CC.TRL_INSP_MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD = BB.TRL_INSP_MLSFC_TYPE_SE_CD AND DD.TRL_INSP_SCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD = CC.TRL_INSP_SCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD ORDER BY DD.TRL_INSP_SCLAS_TYPE_SE_CD
